One question.
Three evidence layers.

RippleMap keeps raw observations, indexed reporting, and model inference visibly separate—so you can inspect the path instead of trusting a black box.

01 / MARKET

Read the market now

Live last price, bid and ask, 24-hour movement, turnover, and instrument metadata arrive directly from Bitget.

02 / SOURCES

Find recent reporting

Current coverage is retrieved as linked research leads. Headlines remain attributed and are never silently promoted into facts.

03 / SYNTHESIS

Trace conditional paths

Gemini proposes mechanisms, confidence, contradictions, watch conditions, and explicit invalidation tests.

Built for research,
not certainty theater.

A market move can coincide with an event without being caused by it. RippleMap makes that limitation part of the product, not a footnote.
